headerDisplay: Choose cameras, live viewing and HomeKit Secure Video recording.

name.title: Homebridge platform name
name.description: Name for this Blink platform instance

deviceId.title: Homebridge connection ID
deviceId.description: Unique identifier for this Homebridge instance (sent to Blink as hardware_id)

deviceName.title: Homebridge device name
deviceName.description: Friendly name for this device (fallback for Device ID)

tier.title: Discovered Blink API Tier
tier.description: Assigned automatically by Blink after sign-in. Shown in connection status; do not choose a tier based on your location.

persistAuth.title: Persist Auth Tokens
persistAuth.description: Hosted sign-in requires persisted tokens across restarts. Managed automatically by the sign-in screen.

trustDevice.title: Trust This Device
trustDevice.description: Mark this Homebridge instance as a trusted device during client verification.

authLocked.title: Lock Authentication
authLocked.description: Lock authentication state after successful login. When locked, stored verification codes are ignored and only token refresh is used. Unlock to force re-authentication.

debugAuth.title: Debug Authentication
debugAuth.description: Enable verbose authentication diagnostics. Sensitive fields are redacted; review logs before sharing.

pollInterval.title: Check Blink for changes every (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often to poll Blink for state changes. Minimum 15 seconds.

motionTimeout.title: Keep motion shown in Home for (seconds)
motionTimeout.description: How long motion detected state stays active before resetting

enableMotionPolling.title: Read motion events from Blink
enableMotionPolling.description: Reads Blink cloud clip events for motion state. Separate from saved USB clip discovery and continuous recording's local video motion; turning this off does not stop permitted recording.

snapshotCacheTTL.title: Snapshot Cache Duration (seconds)
snapshotCacheTTL.description: How long to cache camera snapshots before requesting a fresh one from Blink. Set to 0 to always request fresh snapshots (uses more battery). Default: 60 seconds.

exposeTemperature.title: Expose Camera Temperature
exposeTemperature.description: Expose reported temperature for supported traditional Blink cameras. Adds one metadata request per enabled camera per state poll; does not wake the camera. Restart the child bridge after saving.

persistSnapshotCache.title: Persist Snapshot Cache Until Manual Refresh
persistSnapshotCache.description: Keep the last preview until its Refresh Snapshot switch is used in Home. Overrides preview cache duration.

hksvCameras.title: Cameras selected for HomeKit recording
hksvCameras.description: Choose cameras offered to HomeKit Secure Video. Saved clips use native Blink motion and completed Sync Module USB recordings. Recording permission and audio are managed in Apple Home. Save, then restart the Blink child bridge.

mediaDebug.title: Media diagnostics
mediaDebug.description: Enable bounded, redacted streaming diagnostics. Per-packet and NAL traces are omitted.

debugStreamPath.title: Save raw diagnostic video locally
debugStreamPath.description: Optional folder on the Homebridge host for raw IMMIS .ts diagnostic video. Uses local disk and can contain private footage. Not an HSV or iCloud destination. Leave blank to disable.

maxStreams.title: Simultaneous live viewers per camera
maxStreams.description: Maximum number of simultaneous HomeKit streams for each camera.

enableAudio.title: Camera audio in HomeKit
enableAudio.description: Allows camera audio in both live viewing and HomeKit recordings. Apple Home recording-audio permission must also allow it. Two-way talkback is unavailable.

audioCodec.title: Audio Codec
audioCodec.description: Preferred audio codec for HomeKit streaming.

audioBitrate.title: Audio Bitrate (kbps)
audioBitrate.description: Target audio bitrate for HomeKit streaming.

outputQuality.title: Live-view picture quality
outputQuality.description: Picture preset for live viewing only. Apple Home chooses the HomeKit recording format.

videoBitrate.title: Max Video Bitrate (kbps)
videoBitrate.description: Cap the video bitrate (leave empty to use HomeKit defaults).

softwareEncodingPreset.title: Software Stream Encoding
softwareEncodingPreset.description: Low CPU uses faster video encoding and lower Opus encoding complexity. It may reduce video/audio quality at the same bitrate.

excludedNetworks.title: Excluded Networks
excludedNetworks.description: Network IDs or exact Blink network names to exclude, including all their cameras. Restart the Blink child bridge after changing this setting.

excludeDevices.title: Excluded Devices
excludeDevices.description: List of device serial numbers, IDs, or names to exclude from HomeKit.

deviceNameOverrides.title: Custom Device Names
deviceNameOverrides.description: Override display names for devices in HomeKit.

deviceIdentifier.title: Device Serial / ID
deviceIdentifier.description: The device serial number or numeric ID to rename

customName.title: Custom Name
customName.description: The display name to use in HomeKit

deviceIdentifier.title: Device Serial / ID
deviceIdentifier.description: The device serial number or numeric ID to configure

inputQuality.title: Camera Input Quality
inputQuality.description: Per-camera Blink source quality. Automatic preserves existing quality and remembers first observed input. Explicit selection changes Blink camera configuration and recordings too; dimensions depend on camera model and subscription.

exposeTemperature.title: Expose Temperature
exposeTemperature.description: Override the global temperature setting for this camera. Leave unset to inherit.

motionTimeout.title: Motion Timeout (seconds)
motionTimeout.description: Motion timeout in seconds for this device

syncModuleFeedLimits.title: Sync Module feed limits
syncModuleFeedLimits.description: Optional limits for actual discovered Sync Modules. Each defaults to its associated included camera count. Upstream feeds are shared by live viewing and recording.

hksvSource.title: Default recording source
enumNames: Saved Blink clips (lower idle battery use)
hksvSource.description: Saved clips replay completed Sync Module USB recordings after capture and preparation, without an idle live feed. Continuous mode keeps cameras streaming while Home recording is allowed and increases battery and network use.

syncModuleRecording.title: Sync Module recording overrides

pollIntervalSeconds.title: Check for completed clips (seconds)
pollIntervalSeconds.description: Leave blank to check every 30 seconds. Used only for saved clips; does not start a live feed.

syncModuleRecording.description: Optional source and clip-polling overrides for actual Sync Modules. Omit or use an empty list to inherit the default source and 30-second polling.
